rulesNote: Core competition format is encoded separately. Season-specific PL/EFL handbook access was blocked; registration and financial regulation details need handbook confirmation before enforcement.

FPL2026.coverage: Premier League first-team identities; 25 per club. Source football nationality overrides citizenship order.
FPL2026.attribution: Vaastav Anand; source project MIT notice in data/england/fpl-LICENSE.txt. FPL identity data is attributed to Fantasy Premier League.

TM2025.coverage: Older Championship club affiliation fallback, identity, position, DOB, citizenship and foot. Not verified 2026/27 squads. Current known PL affiliations override this source. Incomplete identities are skipped; remaining first-team places generated. No source ratings or valuations are imported.

EXISTING.coverage: Retained authored real-player-inspired squads for Burnley, West Ham and Wolves, excluding known current Premier League players. Existing database identity facts are not independently reverified here.

ratingsNote: Original authored profiles are reused where present. Other sourced identities get stable procedural game attributes, potential, body and contracts. Those values are not verified real-player abilities or EA ratings. Fictional aliases use nationality-specific name pools. Reserve and U18 players are generated.
